overview: LaDiR is a novel reasoning framework that constructs a latent space for reasoning steps using a VAE and trains a latent diffusion model to iteratively refine and generate diverse reasoning trajectories, demonstrating improved accuracy, diversity, and interpretability in mathematical, coding, and planning tasks.

modules.name: Data Preprocessing and Blockization
modules.description: Handles the parsing and segmentation of chain-of-thought reasoning data into sentence-level blocks, separated from the final answer, preparing the data for encoding into latent thought tokens.

modules.name: VAE Architecture and Latent Space Construction
modules.description: Implements the Variational Autoencoder with a finetuned LLM encoder and a frozen decoder, including robustness augmentations (latent noise, token substitution) to learn compact, semantic latent representations (thought tokens) for each reasoning block.

modules.name: Latent Reasoning Model Architecture
modules.description: Constructs the transformer-based reasoning model that incorporates special tokens (<BOT>, <EOT>, <SOA>), timestep embeddings, and a hybrid attention mask (bidirectional within blocks, causal across blocks) to process and generate latent thought blocks.

modules.name: Flow Matching and Loss Functions
modules.description: Implements the core training objectives including the flow matching loss for latent block denoising, the cross-entropy loss for final answer prediction, and the classification loss for special token prediction.

modules.name: Stage 1: Teacher-Forcing Training Pipeline
modules.description: Orchestrates the first training stage where the reasoning model is conditioned on oracle latent blocks from the VAE, jointly optimizing the flow matching, answer, and special token losses.

modules.name: Stage 2: Rollout Training Pipeline
modules.description: Manages the second training stage to mitigate train-inference mismatch, where the model conditions on its own self-generated latent blocks, allowing answer supervision to backpropagate through the diffusion trajectory.

modules.name: Iterative Denoising Inference Engine
modules.description: Executes the inference process, initializing latent blocks with noise and iteratively denoising them via a flow-matching ODE solver, stopping when the <SOA> token is predicted, before autoregressive answer generation.

modules.name: Diversity Mechanisms for Inference
modules.description: Implements inference-time diversity techniques, including increased initial noise variance and a diversity gradient guidance mechanism that applies a repulsive force between latent tokens in a batch to encourage exploration of diverse reasoning paths.

modules.name: Evaluation Metrics Suite
modules.description: Provides functions to compute all core evaluation metrics used in the paper, including Pass@1, Pass@100 accuracy for reasoning tasks, and Diversity (number of unique valid solutions) for planning tasks.

modules.name: Benchmark Experiment Runner
modules.description: Configures and runs experiments on the suite of benchmarks (MATH, GSM8K, Code, Countdown) against specified baselines, aggregating results for comparison tables.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Sets up controlled experiments to evaluate the impact of key components, such as the rollout training stage, VAE augmentations, block size, latent prediction objective, and diversity guidance hyperparameters.

modules.name: Computational Efficiency and Latency Analysis
modules.description: Measures and compares inference latency, test-time compute scaling (number of denoising steps vs. accuracy), and computational costs against baselines.

modules.name: Interpretability and Qualitative Analysis Tools
modules.description: Generates visualizations and examples for analyzing model behavior, such as decoding latent thought tokens at different denoising timesteps to show iterative refinement, and comparing semantic reasoning trajectories.

modules.name: Configuration, Logging, and Experiment Tracking
modules.description: Manages experiment configurations (hyperparameters, data paths), handles logging of training metrics and losses, and integrates with tracking tools for monitoring and reproducibility.
